name: antigravity
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 当指挥，Gemini 干重活：脚手架、测试、迁移全自动分流。你只盯架构和评审。
tagline_en: Claude conducts, Gemini executes: auto-routes scaffolding, tests, migrations. You focus on architecture—grunt.
desc_en: Run the Antigravity CLI (Gemini) as a collaborating AI inside Claude Code, with intelligent model routing across the software development lifecycle. Claude is the conductor/orchestrator — requirements, architecture, the hard 20%, verification, and review — and routes deterministic, high-volume work (scaffolding, boilerplate, test generation, first-pass review, migrations, web/Vertex AI Search) to
why_zh: 同类工具只会单模型硬扛，它却按任务性质智能分流，让每个模型干最擅长的活，协作不打架。
why_en: Unlike single-model tools, it routes by task type so each AI plays to its strength—true collaboration, not a tug-of-war.
